description: The SharePoint originals the exposed real-case eval items cite (evals/exposed/sources.json: Ricardo's QRM folder files in QCQA, his 12 process-map files in Operations and the SoapBox example archive in AGENTS) read through the GET-only Graph adapter (operating.case_runtime.build_live_readers, SharePointReader) under a probe audience: per drive item the eTag, the byte SHA-256 where pinned (else the quickXorHash from metadata, no download) and, for the archive once its SHA-256 matches, each pinned member's SHA-256. Output: counts, booleans, row indexes and error classes only (no names, paths, ids, URLs or text). Needs the Graph app credentials and SHAREPOINT_SITE_ID (pins the download host). Read-only: GET only, token POST only. Live-unverified until the live check records a result.
notes: Pins come from the source records R and S (blobs in evals/exposed/sources.json evidence_records), observed 2026-10-02 through connectors, never from this repository's runtime. 15 items pin a SHA-256 (2 QRM files and the archive by bytes, the 12 process-map files by retrieved UTF-8 text whose length equals the item size), 2 QRM PDFs pin only a quickXorHash. A changed eTag is reported (etag_current) and fails only through the hash. Row order is sources.json drive_items order. Injected-transport tested (tests/test_eval_exposed_cases.py); daily because the archive is about 31 MB.
